title: Fourier norm under restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $h$ be a sign-valued function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and fix a sign assignment $z$ outside $J$. The Fourier one-norm of the restriction of $h$ to the coordinates in $J$ is at most the Fourier one-norm of $h$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates
